concept.title: Beginners
concept.shortdesc: People who are new to an activity such as dance, exercise, yoga or any other pursuit, or described simply as beginners or novices.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : People who are new to, or have only basic experience of, a physical activity such as dance, group exercise, Pilates, walking, running or strength training.
: People new to, returning to, or experienced in yoga, including those wanting a slower-paced mindful style of practice.
: People described simply as beginners or novices, adult or otherwise, without a specific activity or wider skill range.
